profile.headline: Senior Engineer @ LTK | Angel Investor | AI & Early-Stage Startups
profile.summary:
I’m a self-taught software engineer and angel investor with experience building consumer products at scale and AI startups from zero to one.

At LTK, I work across mobile, backend, web, data, and experimentation on search and product discovery while helping advance AI-first engineering practices. Previously, as employee #1 and Founding Engineer at Santa’s AI Lab, I helped launch eight AI products in 12 months.

I’m particularly interested in AI-native software, consumer technology, marketplaces, and developer tools. I enjoy meeting founders and investors to exchange ideas about products, emerging technology, and company building.

Former NCAA Division I baseball and basketball athlete at Santa Clara University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Build across LTK’s Search and Browse experiences for its Creator and Consumer applications, contributing across iOS, backend systems, web, data, analytics, and experimentation.
• Contributed to product-discovery initiatives that delivered a 9% lift in GMV and a 4.4% lift in product-search conversion.
• Champion AI-first engineering across LTK by evaluating emerging models, coding agents, and developer tools while helping teams adopt effective AI-assisted workflows.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Employee #1 and Founding Engineer at Santa’s AI Lab, an AI product lab backed by $2M+ in funding from Floodgate.
• Led zero-to-one iOS and full-stack development across eight AI products launched in 12 months, spanning healthcare, communication, creator tools, and computer vision.
• Worked directly with the founding team to rapidly prototype, validate, and launch new product concepts, owning development across Swift, SwiftUI, React, and Node.js.
• Built production experiences using OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini models across natural-language processing, speech, and computer vision.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Product Development · Large Language Models (LLM) · Swift (Programming Language) · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Startups

positions.title: Full-Stack and iOS Engineer
positions.description:
Built iOS and full-stack products for clients across entertainment, music, social media, and consumer technology.
• Partnered directly with creators, executives, and operators to translate product ideas into production software.
• Delivered applications using Swift, SwiftUI, React, Node.js, and Firebase.
Selected clients: Feels Music Messaging, Hidden Labs, Player’s Punch, and RFDB.
positions.insights: Skills: SwiftUI · Node.js · Swift (Programming Language) · iOS Design

positions.title: Software Engineer II, iOS
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Built across LTK’s Creator and Consumer iOS applications, shipping creator monetization, product-sharing, and platform-modernization initiatives.

- Created a reusable SwiftUI component library adopted across multiple codebases, helping modernize legacy Objective-C experiences.
- Co-developed LTK’s Creator iOS Share Extension, enabling creators to save products and generate commissionable links directly from mobile browsers while increasing sharing activity.
- Independently developed and launched Fast Pay for the LTK Creator app.

positions.title: iOS Engineer
positions.description:
iOS engineer for early stage tech startup that raised $12M+ from Volition and YC.

- Responsible for leading first ever iOS app launch
- Supported 40k+ orders with seamless processing, including robust payment processing and error handling

positions.title: iOS Developer
positions.description:
Worked as the sole full-time iOS Developer and responsible for rebuilding the entire Version 3 app within 6 weeks

- Rebuild included writing new APIs, data management, Unit Tests, Firebase and Third Party integrations, Swift Package Manager, and personally building the entire new UI using SwiftUI
- Version 3 resulted in the app reaching Top 10 of Sports Chart in App Store and 75k new users in two weeks for a total of over 200k users
- App includes hundreds of athletes like Antonio Brown, Justin Fields, Josh Jacobs, Tacko Fall, and Shareef O’Neal

positions.title: Global IP and Innovation Consultant
positions.description:
PatSnap is a disruptive market-leading provider of intellectual property analytics software. Focused on analyzing technology trends, accelerating innovation, market planning, competitor intelligence and maximizing returns on new & existing IP assets. Used by over 8,000 organizations globally including NASA, United States Department of Defense, Tesla, MIT, Intel, Ford, GE, Disney, Medtronic, Lego, PayPal, IBM, Spotify, Teva Pharmaceuticals, JUUL Labs, Sony, 3M, Goodyear, Johnson & Johnson, Ferrari and Mayo Clinic.

- Top sales development representative in PatSnap West, 4th globally in Q1 2020
- Played a key role on sales team that achieved 104% of quota for Q4 2019

positions.title: Social Media Intern
positions.description:
- Managed social media accounts for a marketing consultant
- Responsible for management, optimization, and growth using engagement tools and automation 
- Focused on user interactivity specifically comments, likes and followers
